target.statement: On one fixed declared dataset path, compare prospectively defined backward empirical windows at approved anchors and all later states, and determine whether empirical distribution/location/scale drift stays within separately approved operational tolerances.
prohibited_claims: minimum sample size theorem for a latent population law

source_to_evaluation_boundary.source_chronology: May contain rows where one or more required horizon features are unavailable.
source_to_evaluation_boundary.predefined_joint_eligibility_rule: Before evaluation dataset identity is frozen, retain only source rows where all required horizons 1/5/10 are AVAILABLE and exact-valid.

chronology.index: 1..n on the bound complete joint chronology

candidate_domain.anchor_rule: j/20 for j=2,...,19 mapped by ceil(j*n/20)

common_n.definition: minimum effective approved anchor N such that for every h in {1,5,10} and every v=N+1,...,n, T_EMP<=tau_T, L_EMP<=tau_L, and S_EMP<=tau_S
common_n.meaning: earliest approved anchor after which the fixed observed path stayed within all approved empirical drift tolerances

chronology_hash_contract.purpose: Bind the exact ordered observation-date sequence used by the R5R evaluator; feature/content integrity remains separately bound by dataset_hash.

normalization: no leading zeros except the single digit 0
negative sign, when present, belongs only on numerator

numeric_contract.decimal_policy_binding: An approved terminating decimal proposal must be converted exactly from its decimal text to a reduced rational before it becomes authoritative.

comparison.rule: a/b <= c/d iff a*d <= c*b using arbitrary-precision integer arithmetic

design_hash_rule: SHA256 of canonical JSON for design_core only

chronology_validation.upstream_joint_eligibility: Source rows lacking any required AVAILABLE/exact-valid horizon may be excluded only before evaluation dataset identity/hash binding, under the predefined eligibility rule with recorded exclusion provenance.
chronology_validation.bound_payload_required_status: AVAILABLE for all three required horizon features on every bound evaluation row
chronology_validation.chronology_key_requirement: unique and strictly increasing after canonical sort; duplicates are invalid rather than silently deduplicated
chronology_validation.limitation_propagation: Dataset limitations including HISTORICAL_TIME_NOT_PROVEN must be copied into the result and cannot be upgraded.

metric_computation.T_EMP_exact: evaluate right-continuous ECDF difference exactly on the union of observed values from anchor and later windows

support_rule.supported: all horizons AND all later states AND all three metrics are within approved tolerances
support_rule.exceeds_policy: all required metrics computable and at least one required comparison exceeds an approved tolerance
support_rule.blocked: metric cannot be computed or a required contract/policy/input is missing

no_supported_anchor.condition: at least one approved candidate is computable, policy is bound, all candidates evaluated, and none is SUPPORTED_WITHIN_POLICY

policy_interface.approved_decimal_binding_rule: Convert approved decimal text exactly to a reduced rational before binding.

failure_taxonomy.INVALID_DATA_IDENTITY: required dataset identity mismatch or missing
failure_taxonomy.INVALID_CHRONOLOGY: bound evaluation chronology has duplicate/noncanonical/non-orderable date identity or otherwise violates chronology contract
failure_taxonomy.MISSING_REQUIRED_HORIZON: one or more required horizons are absent/unavailable inside the already-bound evaluation payload; evaluator must not filter the row
failure_taxonomy.INVALID_FEATURE_LATTICE: feature is not an exact signed integer basis-point value
failure_taxonomy.INSUFFICIENT_EMPIRICAL_WINDOW: joint chronology cannot satisfy frozen window minimum
failure_taxonomy.OUTSIDE_R5R_APPROVED_CANDIDATE_GRID: candidate is outside approved grid; not a policy failure
failure_taxonomy.NO_ELIGIBLE_GRID_ANCHOR: no structural candidate has a full window and later state
failure_taxonomy.ANCHOR_EMPIRICAL_MAD_ZERO: anchor empirical MAD equals zero for a required horizon
failure_taxonomy.NO_COMPUTABLE_APPROVED_ANCHOR: all structurally eligible anchors are blocked from complete metric computation
failure_taxonomy.POLICY_TOLERANCE_UNBOUND: tau_T, tau_L, or tau_S lacks compatible approved binding
failure_taxonomy.WINDOW_PROFILE_MISMATCH: runtime window profile differs from frozen contract
failure_taxonomy.CANDIDATE_DOMAIN_MISMATCH: runtime candidate contract differs from frozen contract
failure_taxonomy.METHOD_CONTRACT_MISMATCH: runtime target/method/hash identity differs from frozen contract
failure_taxonomy.NUMERIC_CONTRACT_MISMATCH: runtime metric or policy numeric representation/comparison semantics differ from R5R_EXACT_RATIONAL_V1
failure_taxonomy.CHRONOLOGY_HASH_CONTRACT_MISMATCH: runtime chronology payload/hash semantics differ from R5R_JOINT_CHRONOLOGY_HASH_V1

R5R_G0_TARGET_METHOD_CONTRACT.required: target and Method Contract V2 frozen with CandidateDomain V1 and Window Profile V1 hashes bound, plus chronology/numeric deterministic semantics frozen

R5R_G1_DATA_IDENTITY_CHRONOLOGY.required: an evaluation dataset identity is explicitly bound and passes chronology/value validation

R5R_G2_WINDOW_CANDIDATE_STRUCTURE.required: frozen window and CandidateDomain contracts compatible with method contract

R5R_G3_POLICY_TOLERANCES.required: R5R-compatible tau_T/tau_L/tau_S and approval authority/reference approved

R5R_G4_DETERMINISTIC_IMPLEMENTATION_VERI.required: implementation passes independent exact fixtures for ECDF, ties, median, MAD, window boundaries, all-later/latest, common-N, and failure paths

deterministic_review_requirements: odd and even window sample medians
missing horizon inside bound payload fail-close

new_contract_version_required_for: joint eligibility or bound-payload missing-horizon semantics change
authoritative numeric representation or policy comparison semantics change

semantic_hash_rule: SHA256 of UTF-8 canonical JSON with recursively lexicographically sorted object keys, compact separators, and semantic_contract_sha256 plus semantic_hash_rule omitted

findings.MUR3-F01: Resolved by PREBOUND_COMPLETE_JOINT_CHRONOLOGY: upstream eligibility before dataset binding; no evaluator row filtering; missing horizon inside bound payload fails closed.
findings.MUR3-F02: Resolved by R5R_JOINT_CHRONOLOGY_HASH_V1 canonical payload + canonical UTF-8 JSON serialization + SHA-256.
findings.MUR3-F03: Resolved by R5R_EXACT_RATIONAL_V1 exact arithmetic and exact <= cross-multiplication comparison; binary-float epsilon forbidden.
